manual_phases.name: OSINT and passive intelligence
tasks: Map the target in dnsdumpster, Censys (also try CDN edge IP), urlscan.io, cylect.io, osint.tools / OSINT framework
Review February notes: web-check.as93.net, subdomainradar.io, urlvoid for geo/reputation
Correlate certificate transparency and historical DNS with subfinder/httpx output

manual_phases.name: Proxy and manual web testing
tasks: Burp Suite + domain_hunter_pro (January) for domain takeovers and scope
OWASP ZAP (February): proxy traffic, active scan, manual fuzzing on authenticated flows
HExHTTP / 403jump when bypassing edge rules — validate findings in staging if available

manual_phases.name: Traffic and artifact analysis
tasks: Capture PCAP or wget mirror, run bulk_extractor on captures or mirrored content (February)
Mantra-style JS review: waybackurls|gau → grep .js → secret patterns (partially automated by api_leak module)

manual_phases.name: Further reading
tasks: OWASP Amass / Dome with API keys when passive sources dry up
Mend Red Teaming Practical Guide (PDF from January note)
